title: BW ESS breaks ground on one of Europe’s largest battery energy…
text:
Saxony-Anhalt, 1 July 2026 —Today BW ESS, the global energy storage owner-operator, breaks ground on one of Europe’s largest battery energy storage projects to date, the 1,000MW / up to 5,700MWh Klostermansfeld BESS.
Located in the Mansfeld-Südharz region, Saxony-Anhalt, in close proximity to the Klostermansfeld substation, the project is the largest of its kind in Germany.  It has the capacity to supply around three million German households with electricity for at least four hours.

title: Holcim partners with BW Ideol to scale up the construction of offshore wind infrastructure | Ideol
text:
Holcim has taken a minority equity ownership in BW Ideol, a pioneer in floating offshore wind technology, to scale up the construction of clean energy infrastructure.
The two companies will form a strategic partnership for the supply of innovative materials to two fabrication lines for floating foundations, developed by BW Ideol in Southern France and Northeast Scotland.

text:

title: Cadeler Announces Signing of an EIFO-Backed Green Term Loan Facility of EUR 247 Million for Wind Apex :: Cadeler A/S (CDLR)
text:
COPENHAGEN, Denmark--(BUSINESS WIRE)--Cadeler has signed an EIFO-backed senior secured green term loan facility of EUR 247 million to finance in part the construction of its third A-class newbuild offshore wind installation vessel, Wind Apex, with delivery expected in Q2 2027.
The 12-year facility is supported by the Export and Investment Fund of Denmark (EIFO) and has been designated as green financing under Cadeler's Green Finance Framework.
